title: Ceylon Vacation Venues
description: A full-stack tourism and travel management platform built with Laravel, featuring tour packages, villas, vehicle rentals, travel services, customer inquiries, and a secure administration panel.
fullDescription: Ceylon Vacation Venues is a comprehensive, mobile-first tourism and travel services web application developed for a Sri Lankan travel business. The platform allows visitors to explore tour packages, discover villas and holiday houses, browse rental vehicles, request visa assistance, arrange baggage transportation, and submit booking inquiries. A secure, role-based administration panel enables authorized staff to manage accommodation listings, tour packages, vehicles, gallery images, blog articles, customer requests, website content, and SEO settings. The application includes SMTP email notifications, dynamic content management, responsive layouts, search-engine optimization, and server-side security controls. Built using Laravel, PHP, MySQL, Blade, Tailwind CSS, Alpine.js, and Vite, the system is designed for performance, maintainability, and scalability.
